narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Brand Endorsement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on summer skin management, specifically addressing the issue of excessive oil production and acne. It transitions from seasonal advice (summer oil control) to a professional explanation of skin problems (clogged pores, mites) and then promotes a specific skincare product (Retinol) from the DRX Series Skincare brand as the ultimate solution.
